title: Get something drawn
intro: Your favourite character, your own character, or you and your other half, drawn in my style. Tell me what you have in mind.

tiers.name: The Bust
tiers.text: Head and shoulders of one character, fully coloured.

tiers.name: The Half Body
tiers.text: One character from the waist up, with room for a pose and an outfit.

tiers.name: The Full Body
tiers.text: One character head to toe, shoes and all.

tiers.name: The Lovers
tiers.text: Two characters together: a couple, best friends, or you and your partner.

steps.title: Send the idea
steps.text: Who or what, the mood, and any reference pictures you have.

steps.title: Quote and sketch
steps.text: You get a price, then a sketch to approve before any colour goes on.

steps.title: Colour
steps.text: I finish the piece and send progress shots along the way.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: A high-resolution file lands in your inbox, ready to print or post.

closedText: Commissions are closed for now. Send the idea anyway and you will hear back when a slot opens.
notes: Fan art and original characters are both welcome.
Personal use unless we agree otherwise.
Turnaround depends on the queue; ask and I will tell you where it stands.
